Punjabi-mediated puttar is explicitly allowed by the addendum; a bare pū requires separate local contraction evidence. Uncertain transfer between Indo-Aryan languages does not prevent this supported family link under the user’s preference.

The n-bearing sister forms are distinguishable; bare bai woman forms require local historical evidence. Uncertain transfer between Indo-Aryan languages does not prevent this supported family link under the user’s preference.
